label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: url = session.getAttribute("partnerCallback").toString() reaches response.sendRedirect() sink. Although url is validated for "https://" prefix, this does not mitigate XSS - attacker-controlled session data containing <script> tags will execute upon redirect. The HTTPS check only ensures transport encryption, not content safety. Resolved sink value depends on session attribute which can be attacker-controlled if session was compromised or pre-populated with malicious data.

evidence.note: Session attribute v flows to url, then to sendRedirect sink - XSS vulnerable redirect
